name: Bruxelles 1893

categories.label: VP on the scoring track
categories.hint: VP gained during play, read after the Public Figure payment below is applied.

categories.label: Public Figure cards not paid for
categories.labelVi: Thẻ Public Figure không trả được
categories.hint: Pay the BF printed on kept Public Figure cards; each one you cannot pay is discarded and costs 5 VP.

categories.label: Construction VP (buildings x Architect level)
categories.labelVi: Điểm xây dựng (số công trình x cấp Architect)
categories.hint: Each Building tile built earns VP equal to your level on the Architect track.

categories.label: Bonus row 1: money (per 4 BF)
categories.hint: Row value = 1 base + 1 per VP symbol on cards tucked in row 1; scored per full set of 4 BF.

categories.label: Bonus row 2: Works of Art
categories.labelVi: Hàng thưởng 2: tác phẩm nghệ thuật
categories.hint: Row value = 1 base + 1 per VP symbol in row 2, per Work of Art still in possession.

categories.label: Bonus row 3: Public Figure cards
categories.hint: Row value = 1 base + 1 per VP symbol in row 3, per Public Figure card kept (after paying).

categories.label: Bonus row 4: Assistants beyond the second
categories.labelVi: Hàng thưởng 4: Assistant từ con thứ 3
categories.hint: Row value = 1 base + 1 per VP symbol in row 4, per Assistant beyond the 2nd (Courthouse ones do not count).

categories.label: Noble materials
categories.hint: 1 VP per Noble material cube; Joker cubes are worthless.

categories.label: Manneken Pis pawn
categories.hint: 5 VP to the player holding the pawn at the end.

tiebreakers.description: The rulebook states no tiebreaker for the final score.

notes: family: auction-money. Game ends after the 5th round once Brussels-board majorities resolve. Step 1 of final scoring: pay Public Figure card costs (BF); each unpaid card is lost and -5 VP on the track; enter the track total after this. Each bonus row has 1 VP symbol built in, plus symbols from tucked Bonus cards; enter that total as rowValue. Rulebook gives no tiebreaker, so shared victory is assumed. 2-player adjustments not modelled. Belle Epoque (2023) edition is a separate template.
